artifact_observations.reasoning: The overhead wires supporting the traffic lights exhibit slight unnatural waviness and inconsistent tension physics. Some wire segments appear to merge slightly with the sky background rather than maintaining sharp, taut lines.
The background elements have a slightly 'smudged' or painterly texture typical of AI generation, lacking the crisp edge definition expected in a daylight photo, though not severely distorted.
The white lane markings on the road show minor inconsistencies in perspective convergence, appearing slightly warped rather than perfectly straight lines receding into the distance.
